citation.title: Developing Autoencoder Models for Multi-Diagnostic Electron Density Processing in Tokamaks within a Scientific Machine Learning Framework
citation.authors: S. Kaldas, R. Rossi, I. Wyss, M. Gelfusa, P. Gaudio

topic: The paper uses autoencoders to fuse synthetic TS, interferometer and polarimeter electron-density signals in a virtual tokamak (TokaLab).
own_question: The authors ask whether multi-diagnostic and supervised autoencoders reduce reconstruction error relative to single-diagnostic models under injected noise and faults.
actual_method_and_evidence: The data are 30,000 synthetic equilibria with an analytic n_e(psi) profile, 10% Gaussian noise and 1% zeroed or outlier points. Training used a single random 70/15/15 split. Results are reported as RMSE/MRE against ideal synthetic values. An Int/Pol-to-TS cross-diagnostic mapping is included as a static, same-instant mapping. The reported 0.24 ms per-sample CPU inference is offline benchmarking only, not a deployment.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Synthetic-data autoencoder fusion of electron-density diagnostics has been explored as a route to robustness against noise and faults.
claim_checks.qualification: The study is synthetic and electron-only, uses analytic profiles, and does not involve CES, ion temperature, KSTAR or temporal prediction.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are same-instant snapshots, so there is no causal or temporal dimension. The authors motivate inferring TS between laser pulses, but they do not test this with time series.
validation_if_relevant: Validation uses a random split of i.i.d. synthetic samples. No experimental or untouched-campaign data are used.
forbidden_inferences: That the approach applies to CES or impurity Ti.
That it was validated on real data or deployed in real time.
That its accuracy transfers to KSTAR.
That the 0.24 ms timing is relevant to our 10 ms budget claims.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most, cite it as an adjacent example of ML multi-diagnostic fusion. Its target, data and design do not overlap with ours.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
